_comment: Per-tool voice approval policy for approval_hook.py.
_values: 'approve' = Polly speaks + wait for yes/no | 'silent' = pass through immediately
_note_timeout: If no voice detected within record_s seconds, timeout_action applies: 'approve' = proceed, 'reject' = block
_note_device: Set 'device' to a substring of your microphone name to override the OS default (run: python -c "import sounddevice; print(sounddevice.query_devices())" to list devices). null = use OS default input device.
